comments.author: Alexander Terp
comments.body: 2026-10-24: not reproduced in 57 runs (45 alone, 12 suite runs three at a time at load 10). Ruled out from code: both forms render quiet from one roster field, nothing clears it between the reads, callsigns do not change. The two text reads never checked their exit status, so a failed read looked exactly like this; 77e34684 asserts it, so a next sighting saying 'muster window failed' means the read failed.

creator: Alexander Terp
description: Seen once 2026-10-24 in a full cargo test -p muster-cli on the Mac mini: at driving_a_window.rs:247 the text muster window did not yet list the pane under hidden as (quiet), though the --json read just before had said so. Passed alone. Looks like a race between the waited-for JSON read and the text read after it.
title: 🎲 driving_a_window::a_pane_can_drive_the_window_it_is_drawn_in saw no (quiet) under hidden
